+component GenericPairSharedSupertypeExclusion
+export Executable
+
+(* Two generic declarations over Thawed[T] and Frozen[T], which extend Readable[T] and exclude each other at one T, exclude at every pair of their instances, since no type extends two instances of Readable, so they are a valid overloading (overloading.tex, section "Declarations with Static Parameters"; types-vals-vars.tex, section "Trait Types"). *)
+
+trait Readable[\E\] end
+trait Frozen[\E\] extends Readable[\E\] excludes { Thawed[\E\] } end
+trait Thawed[\E\] extends Readable[\E\] end
+object FrozenZ extends Frozen[\ZZ32\] end
+object ThawedZ extends Thawed[\ZZ32\] end
+
+copyOf[\T\](a: Thawed[\T\]): String = "thawed"
+copyOf[\T\](a: Frozen[\T\]): String = "frozen"
+
+run(): () = do
+    assert(copyOf(FrozenZ), "frozen", "a Frozen runs the declaration over Frozen")
+    assert(copyOf(ThawedZ), "thawed", "a Thawed runs the declaration over Thawed")
+    println("PASS")
+  end
+
+end
component GenericPairExcludesTogetherWalk
export Executable

(* Two generic declarations over P[T] and Box[T] and over Q[T] and Box[T], where P[T] excludes Q[T] at one T and the object Box fixes one T for both, exclude each other, so they are a valid overloading and each call runs the one its arguments select, with renamed static parameters, where the shared parameter fixes the static argument through a supertype, over sizes, and where the forced static argument would be two types, beside a generic or a plain declaration, too (overloading.tex, section "Declarations with Static Parameters"). *)

trait P[\T\] excludes { Q[\T\] } end
trait Q[\T\] end
object Mixed extends { P[\ZZ32\], Q[\String\] } end
object Box[\T\] end

o[\T\](x: P[\T\], b: Box[\T\]): String = "oP"
o[\T\](x: Q[\T\], b: Box[\T\]): String = "oQ"

trait Pn[\nat n\] excludes { Qn[\n\] } end
trait Qn[\nat n\] end
object MixedSize extends { Pn[\3\], Qn[\4\] } end
object BoxSize[\nat n\] end

r[\T\](x: P[\T\], b: Box[\T\]): String = "rP"
r[\U\](x: Q[\U\], b: Box[\U\]): String = "rQ"

trait R[\T\] end
trait SubR[\T\] extends R[\T\] end
object BoxR[\T\] extends SubR[\T\] end

s[\T\](x: P[\T\], b: R[\T\]): String = "sP"
s[\U\](x: Q[\U\], b: SubR[\U\]): String = "sQ"

w[\nat n\](x: Pn[\n\], b: BoxSize[\n\]): String = "wP"
w[\nat m\](x: Qn[\m\], b: BoxSize[\m\]): String = "wQ"

trait Ring[\T\] end
trait RingZ extends Ring[\ZZ32\] end
trait RingS extends Ring[\String\] end
object Rz extends RingZ end
object Rs extends RingS end

pairOf[\T\](a: Ring[\T\], b: Ring[\T\]): String = "same"
pairOf[\T\](a: RingZ, b: RingS): String = "apart"

plainOf[\T\](a: Ring[\T\], b: Ring[\T\]): String = "same"
plainOf(a: RingZ, b: RingS): String = "apart"

run(): () = do
    assert(o(Mixed, Box[\ZZ32\]), "oP", "a Mixed is a P of ZZ32 and a Q of String, so with a Box of ZZ32 only the declaration over P applies")
    assert(o(Mixed, Box[\String\]), "oQ", "with a Box of String only the declaration over Q applies")
    assert(r(Mixed, Box[\ZZ32\]), "rP", "renamed static parameters: with a Box of ZZ32 only the declaration over P applies")
    assert(r(Mixed, Box[\String\]), "rQ", "renamed static parameters: with a Box of String only the declaration over Q applies")
    assert(s(Mixed, BoxR[\ZZ32\]), "sP", "through a supertype: a BoxR of ZZ32 is an R of ZZ32 only, so only the declaration over P applies")
    assert(s(Mixed, BoxR[\String\]), "sQ", "through a supertype: a BoxR of String is a SubR of String, so only the declaration over Q applies")
    assert(w(MixedSize, BoxSize[\3\]), "wP", "size parameters: with a BoxSize of 3 only the declaration over Pn applies")
    assert(w(MixedSize, BoxSize[\4\]), "wQ", "size parameters: with a BoxSize of 4 only the declaration over Qn applies")
    assert(pairOf(Rz, Rz), "same", "two Rings of one T run the declaration over Ring twice")
    assert(pairOf(Rz, Rs), "apart", "a RingZ and a RingS are Rings of two types, so only the declaration over RingZ and RingS applies")
    assert(plainOf(Rz, Rz), "same", "beside a declaration without static parameters: two Rings of one T")
    assert(plainOf(Rz, Rs), "apart", "beside a declaration without static parameters: a RingZ and a RingS")
    println("PASS")
  end

end
component GenericPairExcludesTogether
export Executable

(* Two generic declarations whose parameter types exclude each other only read whole, through a static argument that another parameter fixes, there or through a supertype, are a valid overloading, beside a generic or a plain declaration, and each call runs the one its arguments select (overloading.tex, section "Declarations with Static Parameters"). *)

trait P[\T\] excludes { Q[\T\] } end
trait Q[\T\] end
object Mixed extends { P[\ZZ32\], Q[\String\] } end
object Box[\T\] end

o[\T\](x: P[\T\], b: Box[\T\]): String = "oP"
o[\T\](x: Q[\T\], b: Box[\T\]): String = "oQ"

r[\T\](x: P[\T\], b: Box[\T\]): String = "rP"
r[\U\](x: Q[\U\], b: Box[\U\]): String = "rQ"

trait R[\T\] end
trait SubR[\T\] extends R[\T\] end
object BoxR[\T\] extends SubR[\T\] end

s[\T\](x: P[\T\], b: R[\T\]): String = "sP"
s[\U\](x: Q[\U\], b: SubR[\U\]): String = "sQ"

trait Ring[\T\] end
trait RingZ extends Ring[\ZZ32\] end
trait RingS extends Ring[\String\] end
object Rz extends RingZ end
object Rs extends RingS end

pairOf[\T\](a: Ring[\T\], b: Ring[\T\]): String = "same"
pairOf[\T\](a: RingZ, b: RingS): String = "apart"

plainOf[\T\](a: Ring[\T\], b: Ring[\T\]): String = "same"
plainOf(a: RingZ, b: RingS): String = "apart"

run(): () = do
    assert(o(Mixed, Box[\ZZ32\]), "oP", "with a Box of ZZ32 only the declaration over P applies")
    assert(o(Mixed, Box[\String\]), "oQ", "with a Box of String only the declaration over Q applies")
    assert(r(Mixed, Box[\ZZ32\]), "rP", "renamed static parameters: the declaration over P")
    assert(r(Mixed, Box[\String\]), "rQ", "renamed static parameters: the declaration over Q")
    assert(s(Mixed, BoxR[\ZZ32\]), "sP", "through a supertype: the declaration over P")
    assert(s(Mixed, BoxR[\String\]), "sQ", "through a supertype: the declaration over Q")
    assert(pairOf(Rz, Rz), "same", "two Rings of one T")
    assert(pairOf(Rz, Rs), "apart", "a RingZ and a RingS")
    assert(plainOf(Rz, Rz), "same", "beside a plain declaration: two Rings of one T")
    assert(plainOf(Rz, Rs), "apart", "beside a plain declaration: a RingZ and a RingS")
    println("PASS")
  end

end
